qualifier: feeding ether lipid and wax synthesis
name: Fatty acid elongation for ether lipid and wax synthesis
rationale: All members build very long-chain acyl-CoAs or their ether-lipid/plasmalogen and wax products; the ether lipid and wax arm separates it from the PUFA-metabolism and peroxisomal-oxidation neighbours.

qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK/p38 activation, ERK feedback inhibition and AP-1
name: Stress MAPK activation, ERK feedback inhibition and AP-1
rationale: Members concern activation and negative feedback of JNK/p38/ERK cascades with AP-1 output; ERK inactivation/feedback distinguishes it from activation-only neighbours and TAK1/AP-1 from the phosphatase neighbour.

qualifier: forebrain and cerebellar progenitor division and layering
name: Brain progenitor division, neuronal migration and layer formation
rationale: Members cover neural progenitor proliferation, radial/tangential neuronal migration and layer formation in cortex, cerebellum and other brain regions, unlike the spinal cord, reelin/dendrite or dopaminergic neighbours.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signalling and their T/NK differentiation effects, distinguishing it from IL-3/5, IL-6 and IL-10/12 family neighbours.

qualifier: in leading-edge protrusion and cell motility
name: Leading-edge actin filament dynamics in cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, capping and bundling in lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and motility, without the Rho-family GTPase cycles of the neighbours.

qualifier: with Na+/H+ exchange and Na+/K+ gradient homeostasis
name: Organelle acidification and sodium/potassium/proton gradient homeostasis
rationale: Members set luminal pH of endosomes, lysosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles plus Na+/H+ exchangers and P-type ATPase cation gradients, unlike phagosome, phospholipid scrambling or anion-exchange neighbours.

name: Serotonin synthesis, secretion and reuptake
rationale: All members concern serotonin production, release and uptake, distinguishing it from monoamine degradation, serotonin receptor and catecholamine neighbours.

name: G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor commitment and transcriptional control of granulopoiesis with G-CSF signalling, unlike macrophage/monocyte, GM-CSF or eosinophil/mast cell neighbours.

name: Selective autophagy and ESCRT-dependent membrane remodelling
rationale: Members span macro/micro/chaperone-mediated and selective autophagy plus ESCRT/MVB sorting, viral budding and exosome biogenesis, which the lysosome-transport, quality-control and cytokinesis neighbours lack in combination.

qualifier: active zone maintenance and endosomal receptor/vesicle recycling
name: Active zone maintenance and endosomal synaptic receptor/vesicle recycling
rationale: Members maintain presynaptic structure and recycle synaptic vesicles and postsynaptic receptors via endosomes, unlike clathrin-endocytosis, AMPA-trafficking or Rab/ARF neighbours.

name: Antioxidant response to oxidative and nitrosative stress
rationale: Members detoxify ROS and respond to peroxide and nitric oxide with BACH1/HMOX1 and redox homeostasis, rather than stress-induced apoptosis, ROS production or ferroptosis/hypoxia.

name: TrkC (NTRK3) signalling through Ras-MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NT-3/NTRK3 signalling via Ras, FRS2/ARMS, RIT/RIN and MAPK/ERK5 cascades, distinguishing it from the NGF/TrkA neighbours.

name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS signalling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS signalling from IGF1R/insulin receptor to AKT2 activation and glycogen synthesis, unlike the MET, EPO and ALK receptor neighbours.

name: Amino acid catabolism centred on glyoxylate and glycine
rationale: Members are broad amino acid/amide catabolism terms plus glyoxylate and glycine metabolism, which the proline, threonine and tyrosine neighbours lack.

name: Pinocytic uptake, early endosome routing and transcytosis
rationale: Members regulate pinocytosis, early endosome localization and onward transport to late or recycling endosomes and transcytosis, unlike macropinocytosis, receptor recycling or Golgi trafficking neighbours.

name: Eye and inner ear development, hearing and balance
rationale: Members build eye (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris) and ear structures and mediate hearing and equilibrioception, unlike photoreceptor-focused retina or cranial nerve/olfactory neighbours.

name: Receptor endocytosis and degradation controlling LDL cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members regulate receptor internalization/degradation and LDL/VLDL receptor clearance in sterol homeostasis, unlike chylomicron/VLDL lipase or cholesterol biosynthesis neighbours.

qualifier: sperm chromatin condensation and protamine exchange
name: Male germline and sperm chromatin compaction
rationale: Members concern spermatogonia, Y-linked genes and sperm/paternal chromatin packaging, distinguishing it from meiosis, piRNA and maternal-to-zygotic neighbours.

name: Chylomicron remodelling by lipoprotein and hepatic lipases
rationale: Members are chylomicron remodelling and LPL/LIPC complex assembly, unlike lipoprotein assembly, clearance or LXR-regulation neighbours.

qualifier: arterial/venous/lymphatic specification and adherens junction control
name: Endothelial fate specification, vasculogenesis and junction remodelling
rationale: Members specify endothelial, arterial, venous and lymphatic cells, form vessels and regulate cadherin junctions, unlike the BMP-driven cardiac and pulmonary vascular neighbours.

name: Naive and memory B cell surface gene signatures
rationale: All members are B cell expression modules centred on surface markers and naive/memory states, unlike the plasma cell, memory-only or germinal centre neighbours.

qualifier: with axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural border
name: Neural plate regionalization with axial mesoderm and midline
rationale: Members pattern the early neural plate, hindbrain and neural border alongside notochord and floor plate formation, unlike spinal cord, Hox cluster, convergent extension or somitogenesis neighbours.

name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-driven lymphocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members drive T, B and mast cell chemotaxis and lymphoid positioning via CXCL12-CXCR4, S1P receptors and Rac, distinguishing it from homing and chemokine/dendritic cell neighbours.

name: piRNA biogenesis and germline transposon silencing
rationale: Members are piRNA biogenesis and piRNA/DNA-methylation silencing of transposons with oocyte construction, unlike spermatid chromatin and zygotic transition neighbours.

name: Negative regulation of TLR2/4-LPS proinflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members dampen TLR2/4 and LPS signalling and IL-1b, IL-6 and TNF production, unlike IL-10/IL-12 or NF-kB/TNF-signalling neighbours.
